notes.title: Meet the Captain
notes.notes: [p]It’s time to reveal another leader featured in the digital adaptation of [i]Lost Ruins of Arnak[/i]. Please welcome [b]the Captain[/b]. His name is Jack Callahan, and he’s a true hero—fearless, hardworking, and yes, quite handsome. :-)[/p][p]From a gameplay perspective, the Captain gives you an extra explorer—always a valuable advantage in worker-placement games. And thanks to his strong relationships with the crew, he can also make use of the abilities of all available assistants on the board. Jack is the kind of leader you’ll always want by your side.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="8nCdMu6xIwA;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Meet the Falconer
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve been working hard on the digital adaptation of Lost Ruins of Arnak, and we’re thrilled to share a little glimpse behind the scenes! [/p][p]Our [b]first pre-alpha prototype[/b] is already up and running, and we can’t wait to show you everything we’ve been working on. But first things first: as promised, the digital version will feature four expedition leaders included in the base game.[/p][p]And today, it’s time to meet the very first one…
 [b]✨ Ainara Altayeva — the Falconer! ✨[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Gda2CGfjJuU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and exclusive reveals from the Lost Ruins of Arnak digital journey. [/p][p]
